hero.description: BevTrace digitizes the supply chain of bottlers and beverage distributors using non-returnable PET containers, joining operations management and the Internet of Things in a single system.
hero.image-alt: Aerial view of a container yard

manager.title: For warehouse managers
manager.text: Prioritize the dispatch queue, control stock and shrinkage, and follow every route from one dashboard.

driver.title: For drivers
driver.text: Get authorized dispatches, verified pallets and clear checkpoints so every delivery is confirmed without paperwork.

shift.title: The Traceability Shift
shift.text: Traditional manual logging is the bottleneck of modern logistics. BevTrace replaces fragmented spreadsheets with a seamless IoT ecosystem, ensuring every PET container is accounted for from production to the final retailer.
shift.manual-text: Inaccurate shrinkage data, delayed route updates, and lack of real-time visibility lead to up to 15% loss in the beverage sector.
shift.iot-text: BevTrace automates asset classification and tracking, providing a single source of truth for managers and drivers alike.

features.title: Mission-Critical Features
features.subtitle: Purpose-built tools designed for the unique demands of high-volume beverage distribution and warehouse management.

queue.title: Dispatch Queue
